DIAGNOSIS READY: Frontotemporal Dementia (behavioral variant)

I have gathered sufficient clinical evidence from your history of disinhibition, apathy, hyperorality (specific food cravings), and significant weight gain over six months, which is highly characteristic of the behavioral variant of frontotemporal dementia. Further neuroimaging is not required to establish this primary diagnosis based on the classic presentation.
